name: Cream Sauce, Warm
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Heat a pint of cream slowly in a double boiler
When nearly boiling, set it off from the fire
Put into it half a cupful of sugar, a little nutmeg or vanilla extract
Stir it thoroughly and add, when cool, the whites of two well-beaten eggs
Set it on the fire in a dish containing hot water to keep it warm until needed, stirring once or more

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Heat a pint of cream slowly in a double boiler
2. When nearly boiling, set it off from the fire
3. Put into it half a cupful of sugar, a little nutmeg or vanilla extract
4. Stir it thoroughly and add, when cool, the whites of two well-beaten eggs
5. Set it on the fire in a dish containing hot water to keep it warm until needed, stirring once or more
